newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Meikles sees strong growth, plans new hotel.
newsitem.headline: Meikles sees strong growth, plans new hotel.

text.p: Meikles Africa Ltd said on Monday it looked forward to a strong Christmas season and that its year results would rise substantially.
The Zimbabwean retail and hotel group also said it planned to build a new five star, luxury hotel in Harare.
"Meikles is enjoying strong trading in all of its divisions and we look forward to a busy Christmas period," said executive chairman John Moxon.

"Overall, the company appears set to enjoy a strong Christmas trading period and the directors remain confident that the results for the year ending 31 March 1997 will be significantly ahead of the previous year," the group said in a statement.

Meikles said that it had acquired a four hectare prime site on the edge of the Chapman International Golf Course in Harare, on which it intends to build a "five star, luxury hotel to meet the requirements of the international businessman".
It said discussions with potential strategic partners continue and the company was hopeful that these would soon be concluded.
Trading in all Meikles' divisions continues to grow, it said.

"Preparations for the launch of the new generation of TM Supermarkets stores in Westgate, Chinhoyi, Karoi and Entimbane are well underway and the possibility of regional expansion is being actively investigated," Meikles said.
Detailing its expansion programme, Meikles said it would be opening another Diskom store by the end of this financial year, increasing the number to 120.

Meikles said it had raised US$71.5 million from its international offering, which was the largest equity offering ever undertaken by a Zimbabwean-based company, following the exercise of an over-allotment option for $3.5 million.
